query ProductStrategy($where: ProductStrategyWhereInput, $orderBy: [ProductStrategyOrderByInput!], $first: Int, $after: String) {
  productStrategy(where: $where, orderBy: $orderBy, first: $first, after: $after) {
    edges {
      node {
        id
        code
        minBatch
        stdBatch
        weight
        active
        byProduct
        kanban
        leading
        manufactured
        nonInventory
        phantom
        purchased
        schedule
        validated
        description
        externalId
        name
        revision
        effectiveAt
        expirationAt
        customData
        integrationData
        productId
        consumptionUnitId
        inventoryUnitId
        purchaseUnitId
        saleUnitId
        strategyStageId
        unitTypeId
        weightUnitId
        productStrategyProcesses {
          edges {
            node {
              
              distribution
              sequence
              unitPerCycle
              productionOperators
              setupOperators
              standardPackQuantity
              unitWeight
              active
              description
              extProcessCode
              externalId
              customData
              integrationData
              cycleTime
              idealDuration
              processDuration
              setupDuration
              standardDuration
              transitAfter
              transitBefore
              processId
              productStrategyId
              defaultInventoryStatusId
              defaultPackagingMaterialId
              documentDesignId
              imageId
              putAwayLocationId
              workunitId
              assemblyBoms {
                edges {
                  node {
                    
                    priority
                    maximumUsage
                    minimumUsage
                    standardUsage
                    active
                    actual
                    standard
                    externalId
                    reference
                    customData
                    integrationData
                    assemblyProductStrategyProcessId
                    componentProductId
                    componentProductStrategyId
                    parentBomId
                  }
                }
              }
              alternateWorkunits {
                edges {
                  node {
                    
                    externalId
                    distribution
                    priority
                    unitPerCycle
                    productionOperators
                    setupOperators
                    active
                    customData
                    integrationData
                    cycleTime
                    idealDuration
                    processDuration
                    setupDuration
                    standardDuration
                    transitAfter
                    transitBefore
                    productStrategyProcessId
                    workunitId
                    defaultInventoryStatusId
                    putAwayLocationId
                  }
                }
              }
              processSteps {
                edges {
                  node {
                    
                    code
                    sequence
                    max
                    min
                    target
                    active
                    perProduction
                    perRun
                    description
                    reference
                    url
                    validString
                    customData
                    integrationData
                    duration
                    fileId
                    imageId
                    productStrategyProcessId
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
